app.name: AI Symptom Chat
app.tagline: A calm space to talk through how you're feeling

disclaimer.banner: This isn't a diagnosis. Always consult a licensed doctor about your health.
disclaimer.consent: I understand this tool does not provide medical diagnosis and is for informational purposes only.

profile.welcomeTitle: Welcome — let's set a few things up
profile.welcomeSubtitle: This takes about 10 seconds. Nothing is sent anywhere except your own browser.
profile.consentRequired: Please confirm you understand this before continuing.

chat.greeting: Hi {{name}}, how are you feeling today? You can describe any symptoms in your own words.
chat.greetingGuest: Hi there, how are you feeling today? You can describe any symptoms in your own words.
chat.newConversationConfirm: Start a new conversation? This clears your current chat history.
chat.errorGeneric: We couldn't reach the assistant. Please check your connection and try again.
chat.rateLimited: You've sent a few messages quickly — please wait a moment before trying again.

wellness.title: A moment to breathe
wellness.subtitle: While you wait, or anytime you need it — a short breathing exercise.
wellness.tip1Body: Water supports nearly every system in your body — keep a glass nearby today.
wellness.tip2Body: Your body repairs itself during rest. Even short breaks add up.
wellness.tip3Body: A short, easy walk can ease tension without adding strain.
wellness.disclaimer: These are general wellness reminders, not medical treatment.

settings.title: Settings
settings.dataNote: Your name and chat history are stored only in this browser — nothing is sent to a server for storage.
settings.clearHistoryConfirm: This will permanently delete your saved conversation on this device. Continue?
settings.aboutBody: AI Symptom Chat is a portfolio demo and does not provide medical diagnosis, treatment, or emergency response. Always consult a licensed doctor for health concerns.
settings.emergencyRegionNote: Used only to show the correct emergency number if a conversation ever flags as urgent.

footer.poweredBy: Powered by Groq AI · Not a substitute for professional medical advice

context.noAssessment: Describe how you're feeling in the chat to see an assessment here.
context.trendEmpty: Once there's more than one assessment, a trend will appear here.
context.wellnessTeaserBody: Try a short breathing exercise, anytime you need it.
